instruments.notes: Participating forward swap executed April 1997; floor $2.10/MMbtu and re-entry price $2.48/MMbtu. Filing states derivatives are swaps with purchased options placed with a major financial institution (not named). Combined fair value of all open derivative contracts at 12/31/1997 was approximately $(1.7) million (not split by instrument).
instruments.evidence_quote:
In April 1997, Penn Virginia executed a contract 
for a participating forward swap for 5,000 MMbtu's per day 
with a floor price of $2.10 per MMbtu and a re-entry price of $2.48 per MMbtu for the period of 
May 1997 through October 1999.

instruments.notes: Second participating forward swap completed September 1997 (additional 5,000 MMbtu/d); floor $2.10/MMbtu and re-entry price $2.35/MMbtu. Combined fair value of all open derivative contracts at 12/31/1997 was approximately $(1.7) million (not split by instrument).
instruments.evidence_quote:
In September 1997, the Company completed a 
second participating forward swap for an additional 5,000 MMbtu's per day 
with a floor price of $2.10 per MMbtu and a re-entry price of $2.35 per MMbtu 
for the period of November 1997 through October 1999.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Company periodically enters derivatives (swaps with purchased options) and fixed-price physical contracts to manage natural gas price risk; hedges when circumstances warrant; ~70% of 1998 production hedged at ~$2.60/Mcf floor.
